source.name: US EPA TRI Basic Data Files
source.verification_scope: Pinned source bytes, exact EPA origin, physical facility identity and time-bound reported parent only; not actual exposure, health injury or a legal finding.

coverage.description: Reviewed TRI facility/year/parent matches in this one supplied EPA file only, not all facilities or all company operations.

records.chemical_identity_note: Unmatched reported chemical/category; do not relabel or collapse into a toxicological species
records.release_boundary: On-site reported air and water releases only. Does not include land releases, off-site transfers, treatment or waste managed; do not sum with other scopes.
records.zero_caveat: EPA Basic files can zero-fill blank or NA quantities; a displayed zero does not prove analytically measured zero.

disclaimers: Source-reported on-site air and water quantities only, never individual exposure or guilt.
TRI Form A zero-fill is excluded; zero in a Form R may reflect EPA's NA/blank standardization.
No corporate total, no national completeness claim, no summing dioxin grams with other chemical pounds.
